segments.text: This is for everyone who doomscrolls Google Maps at 2 a.m. clicking on random islands asking, "What even is this place?" Because someone finally built
the tool we all needed. It's called history, and it lets you click anywhere on a 3D globe. Any island, mountain, tiny Arctic village with like nine
people, and it will actually research the entire history of that location for you. actual research across historical archives, academic papers, and the
